verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party feature for running large SQL operations as batches of retryable tasks, with live progress and pause, retry and cancel controls. Partition operations across tables work by reference without copying rows, and async inserts buffer many small writes, so bulk work across many rows or parts is a core capability. Agents can run SQL over the official MCP server, so they can issue bulk SQL directly. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the batch-job feature can be driven by agents (via MCP or CLI) rather than only by humans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk-operation behavior.
